entities.name: 5GSM capability
entities.description: Information element indicating the 5G session management capabilities supported by the UE.

entities.name: PDU session establishment
entities.description: Procedure where the UE requests to establish a new PDU session.

entities.name: PDN connection transfer
entities.description: Procedure where the UE requests to transfer an existing PDN connection.

entities.name: Relevant 5GSM capability
entities.description: Condition where any of the 5GSM capabilities supported by the UE is relevant for the PDU session.

relations.description: The PDU session establishment procedure includes the 5GSM capability IE when relevant capabilities are present.
The PDN connection transfer procedure includes the 5GSM capability IE when relevant capabilities are present.
The inclusion of the 5GSM capability IE is guarded by the condition that relevant capabilities are present.
